tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows elevated NT-proBNP, suggestive of possible heart failure or cardiac strain. There is mild normocytic anemia (low RBC, hemoglobin), increased red cell distribution width, and high hematocrit, which may indicate early anemia or dehydration. LDL cholesterol is elevated, increasing cardiovascular risk. Mild metabolic acidosis is suggested by low CO₂ and high chloride. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended.
